panel.scopeNoticeStrong: Foreshadowings do not automatically rewrite text you have already written
panel.scopeNoticeWhen: when generating or continuing that chapter
panel.scopeNoticeBody1: Foreshadowings do not automatically rewrite text you have already written. After assigning plant / echo / resolve chapters, {{when}}, the AI injects them as writing-task reminders into the context.
panel.scopeNoticeBody2: There is no one-click button to insert foreshadowings into finished prose; to add clues to existing text, edit manually or use the review / rewrite tools.
panel.guideBody1: This panel manages planting, echoing, and resolving tasks so your finished manuscript stays untouched.
panel.guideBody2: Once you set «plant chapter / echo chapter / resolve chapter», those tasks enter the context for chapter generation, continuation, and quality review.
panel.guideBody3: If the chapter is already complete, return to the prose page and manually fill in or continue writing per task, or regenerate, then advance the foreshadowing status to «planted / echoed / resolved».
